title: 第9章  天品功法，朕敢传下去！
slug: 开局自曝系统父皇举国助我娶妻
content_zh:
她的声音清冷，却又带着一种安抚人心的力量。
“陛下他……”
李擎苍想说陛下的旨意太过荒唐，但话到嘴边，又咽了回去。
君就是君，臣就是臣。
“为父只是不懂，陛下的深意到底是什么。”
他最终只能如此说道。
李青鸾却是轻轻摇头。
她走到窗边，看着院中的一株腊梅，忽然开口问道：
“父亲，当今陛下的龙体如何？”
李擎苍一愣，不明白女儿为何突然问这个。
他下意识地回答：
“陛下龙体安康，正值鼎盛之年。若是有朝一日能突破到化龙境，更可增添数百年寿元。”
李青鸾点了点头，又问：
“那父亲可曾有过，站队某位皇嗣的想法？”
李擎苍的眉头立刻拧了起来，斩钉截铁地摇头。
“胡说！为父只忠于陛下一人！此生绝不可能投奔任何皇子，参与夺嫡之争！”
这是他的底线，也是他身为车骑大将军的立身之本。
李青鸾的唇边，逸出一丝极淡的笑意。
“既然如此。”
她转过身，清澈的眸子静静地注视着自己的父亲。

“那父亲，还有什么可以忧虑的？”
李擎苍彻底被问住了。
李青鸾继续说道：
“明眼人都知道，陛下赐下的这桩婚事，是女儿受了委屈，是将军府受了委屈。”
“陛下，他会不知道吗？”
“既然知道，却依然如此行事，那便意味着，在陛下心中，这份委屈是必须的。”
“而日后，他也必然会从其他地方，将这份委屈，加倍补偿给父亲。”
一字一句，清晰地传入李擎苍的耳中。
这位在战场上所向披靡的大将军，此刻脑子里却是一片空白。
他怔怔地看着自己的女儿，仿佛第一天认识她一般。
李青鸾走到那件华丽的嫁衣前，伸出纤纤玉指，轻轻拂过上面精美的刺绣。
“这桩婚事，于女儿而言，不是屈辱。”
“于父亲而言，更不是陛下的敲打。”
“它只是……陛下提前支付给我们李家的一份，无比丰厚，也无比安稳的——未来。”
李青鸾的话音落下，闺房内陷入了长久的寂静。
而在遥远的皇宫深处，御书房内。
那股压抑了整座皇宫六天六夜的恐怖气息，正在以一种奇妙的韵律缓缓收敛。
盘坐于龙床之上的赵道霆，身体内部发出了江河奔腾般的轰鸣。
四肢百骸之中，一道道金色的神曦取代了原有的真元。
在他的经脉中肆意流淌，每一次循环，都在洗涤着他的肉身与神魂。

这便是天品功法《大道天衍经》的玄妙之处。
它并非是在原有基础上修补，而是彻底的推倒重建！
将原本大周皇室传承了数百年的功法根基，尽数废除。
而后以一种更加霸道、更加玄奥的方式，重塑道基！
赵道霆猛地睁开双眼，两道宛如实质的金光自他眸中迸射而出，将前方的空气都洞穿，发出嗤嗤的声响。
他缓缓起身，周身骨节发出一连串噼里啪啦的爆响，如同炒豆子一般。
一股前所未有的强大之感，充斥着他的四肢百骸。
四极境巅峰！
只差临门一脚，便可打破桎梏，演化龙脉，踏入化龙之境！
届时，他将拥有超过八百年的寿元，足以将大周王朝，亲手推上皇朝之位！
“天品功法……果然神妙无双。”
赵道霆摊开手掌，感受着体内那股奔腾不息的金色力量，脸上浮现出一抹久违的激动。
这便是他那个废物儿子，赵辰安带来的天大机缘！
御书房厚重的大门，无声无息地向两侧滑开。
守候了整整六天六夜的总管太监魏公公，一个激灵，连忙跪伏在地，声音带着一丝颤抖。
“恭迎陛下出关！”
赵道霆迈步而出，龙行虎步，周身那股磅礴的气息已经尽数收敛。
看上去与往日并无不同，但魏公公却能感觉到，眼前的帝王，仿佛与这片天地都更加契合了。
“起来吧。”
赵道霆的声音平淡，却带着一股不容置疑的威严。

“谢陛下！”
赵道霆一边朝着殿内走去，一边随口问道：
“朕闭关这几日，朝中可有大事发生？”
魏公公亦步亦趋地跟在身后，低着头，恭敬地回禀。
“回陛下，朝堂一切安稳。只是……三皇子回府禁足前，去过永和宫。”
“淑贵妃这几日，日日都来御书房外求见，想来是为三皇子说情。”
赵道霆的脚步没有丝毫停顿。
“还有呢？”
“朝中百官，对陛下为十六皇子与李将军之女赐婚一事，颇有议论。”
“不过……车骑将军府那边，李将军一直没有任何动静，只是默默地为小姐准备着嫁妆。”
听到这里，赵道霆的脚步终于停了下来。
赵道霆的脸上，缓缓露出一丝满意的笑容。
李擎苍此人，勇猛有余，谋略不足，但胜就胜在两个字——忠诚！
而他的女儿李青鸾，却是个玲珑剔透的聪明人。
有女如此，李擎苍能压下所有不满，遵从朕的旨意，倒也不算出人意料。
朕的儿子，不能修行。
那朕，就为他铺好一条通天大道！
李擎苍，便是朕为他选的第一块基石！
原本，这《大道天衍经》就应该是皇室不传之秘，绝不可外泄。
但规矩是死的，人是活的。

为了安儿的未来，为了大周的江山，些许祖制，破了又何妨！
一个化龙境的李擎苍，远比十个道宫境的李擎苍，更有价值！
就算李擎苍资质差了点，无法突破到化龙境，那也可以成为他的助力。
毕竟赵道霆的眼光可从没放在眼前的得失之上。
他看的更远，要的更多。
而且对于李擎苍来说，这不仅是赏赐，更是一道枷锁，一道将李家与皇室，与赵辰安，彻底绑死在一起的枷锁！
想到此处，赵道霆心中再无半分犹豫。
他重新坐回龙椅之上，手指轻轻敲击着桌面，整个人的气势在这一刻变得深不可测。
“传旨。”
魏公公立刻躬身肃立。
“传，车骑将军李擎苍，觐见。”
content_en:
Her voice was cold, but it had a soothing power.
"Your Majesty, he..."
Li Qingcang wanted to say that His Majesty's decree was too ridiculous, but when the words came to his lips, he swallowed them back.
The king is the king, and the minister is the minister.
"As a father, I just don't understand what His Majesty's deep meaning is."
That was all he could finally say.
Li Qingluan shook his head gently.
She walked to the window, looked at a wintersweet in the yard, and suddenly asked:
"Father, how is your Majesty's dragon body now?"
Li Qingcang was stunned and didn't understand why his daughter suddenly asked this.
He answered subconsciously:
"Your Majesty's dragon body is in good health and is in its prime. If you can one day break through to the realm of dragon transformation, you can add hundreds of years to your life."
Li Qingluan nodded and asked again:
"Have you ever had the idea of siding with a certain emperor's heir?"
Li Qingcang's brows immediately knitted together and he shook his head resolutely.
"Nonsense! As a father, I am only loyal to His Majesty! I will never defect to any prince in this life and participate in the battle for the right to inherit the throne!"
This is his bottom line and the foundation of his status as a general of cavalry.
A faint smile escaped Li Qingluan's lips.
"In that case."
She turned around and stared at her father quietly with her clear eyes.
"Then father, what else can you worry about?"
Li Qingcang was completely stunned.
Li Qingluan continued:
"Everyone with a discerning eye knows that the marriage granted by His Majesty is because my daughter has been wronged and the general's mansion has been wronged."
"Your Majesty, wouldn't he know?"
"Since you know it and still act like this, it means that in your Majesty's heart, this grievance is necessary."
"And in the future, he will definitely double compensate his father for this grievance from other places."
Every word came clearly to Li Qingcang's ears.
This general who was invincible on the battlefield had a blank mind at the moment.
He stared at his daughter blankly, as if it was the first day he met her.
Li Qingluan walked to the gorgeous wedding dress, stretched out her slender jade fingers, and gently brushed the exquisite embroidery on it.
"This marriage is not a humiliation for my daughter."
"For my father, it is not His Majesty's beating."
"It's just... His Majesty's advance payment to our Li family. It's an extremely rich and extremely stable future."
After Li Qingluan finished speaking, the boudoir fell into a long silence.
And deep in the distant palace, in the royal study.
The terrifying aura that had suppressed the entire palace for six days and six nights was slowly converging with a strange rhythm.
Zhao Daoting, who was sitting cross-legged on the dragon bed, roared like a rushing river from inside his body.
Among the limbs and bones, streaks of golden Shen Xi replaced the original true energy.
It flowed freely through his meridians, washing his body and soul with every cycle.
This is the mystery of the Tianpin Kung Fu "Dao Tian Yan Jing".
It is not a repair on the original basis, but a complete rebuild!
All the foundations of the martial arts that had been passed down by the Zhou royal family for hundreds of years were abolished.
Then, he reshaped Daoji in a more domineering and mysterious way!
Zhao Daoting opened his eyes suddenly, and two rays of golden light that looked like substance shot out from his eyes, piercing the air in front of him and making a hissing sound.
He stood up slowly, and his joints made a series of crackling sounds, like fried beans.
An unprecedented sense of power filled his limbs.
The pinnacle of the Four Extremes Realm!
It only takes one final step to break the shackles, evolve the dragon's veins, and step into the realm of dragon transformation!
By then, he will have a life span of more than 800 years, enough to push the Zhou Dynasty to the throne with his own hands!
"Tianpin Kung Fu... is indeed unparalleled."
Zhao Daoting opened his palms, feeling the endless golden power in his body, and a long-lost excitement appeared on his face.
thisIt was the great opportunity brought by his good-for-nothing son, Zhao Chenan!
The heavy door of the imperial study room slid open to both sides silently.
Eunuch Wei, the eunuch in charge who had been waiting for the whole six days and nights, was so excited that he knelt down quickly, his voice trembling.
"Congratulations to Your Majesty for coming out of seclusion!"
Zhao Daoting stepped out, with the stride of a dragon and a tiger, and the majestic aura around him had completely subsided.
It looked the same as before, but Eunuch Wei could feel that the emperor in front of him seemed to be more in tune with the world.
"Get up."
Zhao Daoting's voice was calm, but it carried an unquestionable majesty.
"Thank you, Your Majesty!"
Zhao Daoting asked casually as he walked towards the palace:
"I have been in seclusion for the past few days. Will anything big happen in the DPRK?"
Eunuch Wei followed him step by step, lowered his head, and reported back respectfully.
"Your Majesty, everything is safe in the court. It's just that... the third prince went to Yonghe Palace before returning to the palace for confinement."
"Concubine Shu has been coming outside the imperial study every day to ask for an audience these past few days. I think she came to intercede for the third prince."
Zhao Daoting's footsteps did not pause at all.
"What else?"
"All the officials in the court are quite discussing the marriage granted by Your Majesty to the sixteenth prince and the daughter of General Li."
"But... General Li has been silent at General Chariot's Mansion. He is just quietly preparing a dowry for the young lady."
Hearing this, Zhao Daoting finally stopped.
A satisfied smile slowly appeared on Zhao Daoting's face.
Li Qingcang is a man who is more than brave but lacking in strategy, but victory lies in two words - loyalty!
But his daughter Li Qingluan is an exquisite and smart person.
With a woman like this, it is not unexpected that Li Qingcang can suppress all dissatisfaction and obey my will.
My son cannot practice cultivation.
Then I will pave a road to the sky for him!
Li Qingcang is the first cornerstone I chose for him!
Originally, this "Dao Tian Yan Sutra" was supposed to be a secret that was not passed down to the royal family and could never be leaked.
But rules are dead and people are alive.
For the sake of An'er's future, for the sake of Dazhou's empire, it doesn't matter if some of the ancestral system is broken!
One Li Qingcang at the Dragon Transformation Realm is far more valuable than ten Li Qingcang at the Dao Palace Realm!
Even if Li Qingcang's qualifications are a bit poor and he can't break through to the Dragon Transformation Realm, it can still be his help.
After all, Zhao Daoting never puts his eyes above the immediate gains and losses.
He sees further and wants more.
And for Li Qingcang, this is not only a reward, but also a shackle, a shackle that completely ties the Li family, the royal family, and Zhao Chenan together!
Thinking of this, Zhao Daoting no longer hesitated in his heart.
He sat back on the dragon chair and tapped his fingers on the table. His aura became unfathomable at this moment.
"Deliver the message."
Eunuch Wei immediately bowed and stood in awe.
"It's passed that General Li Qingcang of Chariots and Cavalry is here to see you."
